farm_buildings_beer_served_valid.name: farm_buildings_beer_served_valid
farm_buildings_beer_served_valid.value: "farm_buildings"."beer_served" >= 0 AND "farm_buildings"."beer_served" < 2 AND ("farm_buildings"."beer_ready_at" IS NOT NULL OR "farm_buildings"."beer_served" = 0)

farms_carried_item_quantity_in_range.name: farms_carried_item_quantity_in_range
farms_carried_item_quantity_in_range.value: "farms"."carried_item_quantity" >= 0 AND "farms"."carried_item_quantity" <= CASE WHEN "farms"."carried_item_key" = 'barley' THEN 16 ELSE 2 END

farms_gathering_fields_together.name: farms_gathering_fields_together
farms_gathering_fields_together.value: ("farms"."gathering_item_key" IS NULL AND "farms"."gathering_column" IS NULL AND "farms"."gathering_row" IS NULL AND "farms"."gathering_started_at" IS NULL AND "farms"."gathering_completes_at" IS NULL) OR ("farms"."gathering_item_key" IS NOT NULL AND "farms"."gathering_column" IS NOT NULL AND "farms"."gathering_row" IS NOT NULL AND "farms"."gathering_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "farms"."gathering_completes_at" IS NOT NULL)

shekel_transactions_reward_or_trade.name: shekel_transactions_reward_or_trade
shekel_transactions_reward_or_trade.value:
("shekel_transactions"."type"::text = 'request_reward' AND "shekel_transactions"."request_customer" IS NOT NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."item_key" IS NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."item_quantity" IS NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."unit_price" IS NULL)
      OR ("shekel_transactions"."type"::text IN ('porter_hire', 'building_upgrade', 'building_construction', 'crop_planting') AND "shekel_transactions"."request_customer" IS NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."item_key" IS NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."item_quantity" IS NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."unit_price" IS NULL)
      OR ("shekel_transactions"."type"::text NOT IN ('request_reward', 'porter_hire', 'building_upgrade', 'building_construction', 'crop_planting') AND "shekel_transactions"."request_customer" IS NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."item_key" IS NOT NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."item_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "shekel_transactions"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL)

ziggurat_foundations_timing.name: ziggurat_foundations_timing
ziggurat_foundations_timing.value:
("ziggurat_projects"."foundations_started_at" IS NULL AND "ziggurat_projects"."foundations_complete_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("ziggurat_projects"."fundraising_opened_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ziggurat_projects"."foundation_clay" = 30 AND "ziggurat_projects"."foundation_reed" = 15
      AND "ziggurat_projects"."foundations_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ziggurat_projects"."foundations_complete_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "ziggurat_projects"."foundations_complete_at" = "ziggurat_projects"."foundations_started_at" + interval '6 hours')
